elements_not_encoded.text: If gonococcal conjunctivitis likely, give ceftriaxone1 250mg IM and azithromycin 1g orally.
If orbital cellulitis likely, give ceftriaxone 2g IV2/IM. Avoid injecting > 1g IM at one injection site.
If chemical burn: irrigate eye for at least 30 minutes with 1-3 litres sodium chloride 0.9% or sterile water until pH 7.43. If pain, instil 1 drop tetracaine 1%
If penetrating/metallic foreign body: avoid removing, cover gently. Avoid lying flat. If deep corneal/scleral injury and transfer delay, instil 1 drop atropine
